```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(epitools)
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 0: Check the column names in the data
# Look for the Not Determined column in the list this prints.
agg_lang_3group <- read.csv("/Users/maiko/Desktop/EDLD652_Diss/Data/agg_by_lang_3group.csv")
names(agg_lang_3group)
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 0b: Type the EXACT Not Determined column name from Step 0 here
# (for example "Not.Determined" or "Not_Determined")
nd_col <- "Not.Determined"
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 1: Create Not_Determined and Not_NotDetermined columns
df_lang_nd <- agg_lang_3group %>%
  rename(Not_Determined = all_of(nd_col)) %>%
  mutate(Not_NotDetermined = rowSums(select(., -Primary.Language, -Not_Determined)))

df_lang_nd
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 2: Calculate state totals for Not Determined and all other exits
total_nd_all    <- sum(df_lang_nd$Not_Determined)
total_notnd_all <- sum(df_lang_nd$Not_NotDetermined)
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 3: Define function to compute odds ratio for Not Determined by language group
# Each group is compared with all other children in the dataset
get_nd_or <- function(row_index) {
  group <- as.character(df_lang_nd$Primary.Language[row_index])
  a <- df_lang_nd$Not_Determined[row_index]
  b <- df_lang_nd$Not_NotDetermined[row_index]
  c <- total_nd_all - a
  d <- total_notnd_all - b

  if (any(is.na(c(a, b, c, d))) || any(c(a, b, c, d) < 0)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  mat <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  dimnames(mat) <- list(
    Group = c(group, "All other children"),
    Exit  = c("Not Determined", "Other exits")
  )

  oddsratio(mat)
}
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 4: Compute odds ratios for all language groups
nd_odds_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_lang_nd)), get_nd_or)
names(nd_odds_results) <- df_lang_nd$Primary.Language
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 5: Create summary table of odds ratios and p-values
summary_df_odds_nd_lang <- lapply(nd_odds_results, function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    data.frame(Odds_Ratio = NA, Lower_CI = NA, Upper_CI = NA, P_Value = NA)
  } else {
    data.frame(
      Odds_Ratio = x$measure[2, 1],
      Lower_CI   = x$measure[2, 2],
      Upper_CI   = x$measure[2, 3],
      P_Value    = x$p.value[2, 1]
    )
  }
}) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "Primary.Language") %>%
  mutate(
    Odds_Ratio = round(Odds_Ratio, 2),
    Lower_CI   = round(Lower_CI, 2),
    Upper_CI   = round(Upper_CI, 2),
    P_Value    = signif(P_Value, 3)
  )

# You should see: 3 rows. Check against Table 3:
# English 0.86 [0.67, 1.10], Spanish 1.12 [0.80, 1.56], Other 1.16 [0.85, 1.58]
summary_df_odds_nd_lang
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 6: Compute Cohen's h for Not Determined (same method as the Withdrawn script)
df_lang_nd <- df_lang_nd %>%
  mutate(Total_Exits = Not_Determined + Not_NotDetermined)

total_exits_all <- sum(df_lang_nd$Total_Exits)

compute_cohens_h <- function(p1, p2) {
  2 * abs(asin(sqrt(p1)) - asin(sqrt(p2)))
}

cohens_h_values <- numeric(nrow(df_lang_nd))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_lang_nd))) {
  p1 <- df_lang_nd$Not_Determined[i] / df_lang_nd$Total_Exits[i]
  other_nd    <- total_nd_all - df_lang_nd$Not_Determined[i]
  other_total <- total_exits_all - df_lang_nd$Total_Exits[i]
  p2 <- other_nd / other_total
  cohens_h_values[i] <- compute_cohens_h(p1, p2)
}

summary_df_odds_nd_lang$Cohens_h <- round(cohens_h_values, 2)
```

```{r}
# ✅ Step 7: Save Not Determined odds ratio and Cohen's h summary to CSV
write.csv(
  summary_df_odds_nd_lang,
  "/Users/maiko/Desktop/EDLD652_Diss/Data/summary_notdetermined_by_language.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
